SHORT.TITLE: Welcome to VITA MOOR SPA & ESTHETICS
SHORT.SUB_LEAD_1: Your haven for a rejuvenating & holistic spa experience.
SHORT.SUB_LEAD_2: Visit us now at Dream Lagoon Resort, Marsa Alam

FULL.CARD1: Moor Spa was founded in 2006 in Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt, through a prestigious Egyptian–Italian partnership. Since then, we’ve proudly welcomed guests from all over the world with natural wellness experiences in modern, state-of-the-art facilities.
FULL.CARD2: Our menu features over 70+ treatments, each crafted with care to promote long-term wellbeing and balance.
FULL.CARD3: We take pride in our expert team, whose dedication ensures every visit provides real results and an unforgettable experience.

PRODUCTS.HEADING: Our 100% Natural Products
PRODUCTS.P1: At VITA MOOR Spa & Esthetics, we exclusively use the award-winning Moor Spa® line — a skincare collection crafted with 100% naturally derived ingredients.
PRODUCTS.P2: By blending the purifying essence of Moor with botanical extracts and essential oils, Moor Spa® delivers safe, effective solutions for every skin and body type.
PRODUCTS.P3: Unlike many brands labeled 95% or 99% natural, Moor Spa® guarantees absolutely no synthetics, parabens, or harsh chemicals — making it one of the safest product lines in the spa industry.
